34: [...] And through this introduction a saying in Sefer HaBahir [Sefer HaBahir 16] becomes clear, and this is what it says: ‘Rabbi Rechumai said: “The light preceded the world, as “cloud and darkness [are] His surroundings” [Psalms 97:2], as it is said: “And God said: ‘Let there be light’, and there was light.” [Genesis 1:3]. They said to him: ‘Prior to the formation of your son you will [already] make a crown?’. He said to them: ‘Yes. To what is this matter similar? To a king who desired a son. And he found a beautiful, praiseworthy, excellent crown, and he said: ‘Keep this for my son for his head, as it suits him’. They said to him: ‘He knows that his son [will be] worthy of it’. He said to them: ‘Be silent, thus he/it went up in thought, and he/it is known, as it is said: “and thinkers of thoughts” [Exodus 35:35; other versions refer to II Samuel 14:14 here].’ End of citation.
